description:
O'Seollem, a withdrawn student, has fallen in love with her gamemate, 'Corrupted Excali', and was building a romantic relationship... But a sudden breakup occurs. The excitement at the beginning that she had when studying now ends with the power of anger and manages to get into a prestigious university where 'Corrupted Excali' attends! Whose name and face are unknown.

Who the hell is this guy? An exciting romance where she is looking for her male lead.
